messages:
morgan: Heads up — noticed a hole in the hourly aggregates for 2026-03-20 10:00Z that looks like late nearline events never rehydrated. :eyes:
lee: ugh, saw that in the dashboard too. which metric is dropping?
 morgan: active_sessions_hourly, tenant=payments. counts dip to ~60% of expected for that hour. spike in late-arrivals ingestion lag around same window.
 sasha: likely the nearline consumer backpressure. did the replay job even pick up that shard?
 taylor: quick check: ops-bot says replayer for shard-43 exited with OOM at 2026-03-20T11:02Z.
 ops-bot: Replayer shard-43 terminated: OOM at 2026-03-20T11:02:13 (pid 1423). Logs: /var/log/replayer/shard-43/2026-03-20.log
 lee: okay — shard died mid-replay, so late events never applied. we should run a targeted rehydrate, not a full backfill.
 morgan: agree. propose nearline-rescue run: only tenant=payments, hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z, idempotent apply, low concurrency.
 sasha: +1. add KV-cache-warm step so queries aren't cold after apply. also route the job to dedicated-reserved pool so it doesn't compete with regular replays.
 taylor: what about quota? console shows rehydrate budget for today is ~60% used. running on dedicated-reserved pool avoids shared slot quota but still needs reserved capacity ticket if >30m.
 morgan: estimated run ~12m on dedicated 4-gpu, safe. I'll file a short reserve request.
 lee: can we gate with a canary: replay a 10% sample first and compare aggregate delta, then full rehydrate if diff >5%?
 sasha: yes — run sample: --sample-rate=0.1 then compare pre/post on a local dev dashboard query.
 morgan: sample command (dry-run):
```
run_rehydrate --hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z --tenant=payments --sample-rate=0.1 --apply=false --cohort=nearline
```
 taylor: after sample approves, full run:
```
run_rehydrate --hour=2026-03-20T10:00Z --tenant=payments --apply=true --concurrency=2 --target-pool=dedicated-reserved
```
 lee: add alerting hook to notify #incidents if delta > 10% post-apply. also add a console flag so PMs can see this hour is being rehydrated.
 sasha: I'll add a small dashboard panel and flag in the console: rehydrate_in_progress:payments:2026-03-20T10:00Z
 ops-bot: Reservation request created: ticket RES-7891 for 4-gpu dedicated pool, start 2026-03-21T02:00Z UTC, duration 1h.
 morgan: sweet. I'll run the sample at 02:10 and post results.
 lee: if sample looks good, let's run full at 02:30 and watch the tracing spans for KV cache warms.
 taylor: one more ops-safety: include --idempotency-check and dry-run apply diff export to s3://redwood-replays/payments/2026-03-20-10-diff.json
 sasha: noted. also record the rollback plan in the ticket: how to revert (re-apply baseline snapshot) and contact list.
 morgan: plan set. I'll update RES-7891 with commands/results. pinging @sasha for dashboard patch and @taylor for run. :thumbsup:
 lee: thanks. please paste the pre/post delta here once done.
 morgan: will do.
 ops-bot: Run status: sample job completed at 2026-03-21T02:18Z. results: delta +6.3% on active_sessions_hourly (tenant=payments).
 lee: +6.3% — above our 5% threshold. greenlight for full apply.
 taylor: kicking full job now. monitoring logs.
 morgan: seeing steady apply throughput, shard-43 replay resuming.
 sasha: dashboard shows counts climbing back to expected. cc:product for visibility.
 ops-bot: Full rehydrate finished at 2026-03-21T02:44Z. post-apply delta +6.1% (expected matched). no errors.
 lee: awesome. closing loop: we should add a small safety in console to auto-suggest nearline-rescue when an hourly aggregate drops >20% and a shard OOM is present.
 morgan: created RFC issue #RI-1242 for console hint and automated canary suggestion.
 taylor: nice. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
